name: SnapBlog
author: Dev Connection LTDA

sections.description:
SnapBlog is a WordPress plugin that allows you to import content from the SnapBlog API directly into your WordPress site as posts. The plugin automatically imports posts, images, and videos, and can be configured to run on a schedule or manually.

Features

  • Import posts from SnapBlog API
  • Schedule automatic imports
  • Import images and videos as featured media
  • Organize imported posts by category
  • Simple and intuitive interface

External services

This plugin connects to an API to retrieve information from Instagram posts and uses AI to convert them into blog articles. The service is provided by SnapBlog. For more information, please refer to the Terms of Use (https://snapblog.ai/term) and the Privacy Policy (https://snapblog.ai/privacy).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/snapblog directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the SnapBlog screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
How do I get an API key?

You’ll need to register for an SnapBlog account at https://snapblog.com.br

How often does the plugin import new content?

By default, it checks for new content every 12 hours, but you can also trigger an import manually from the admin page.
